name: imessage-assistant

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=web; wait
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=web && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=web

description: Read and send iMessage, SMS and RCS from any device, self-hosted on your own Mac over Tailscale or Cloudflare Access.
author: Ryan Auhl
